declared_purpose: Generate publication-quality chart images from supplied data using a headless Node.js workflow. The entry explicitly requires sending the image to the user's channel; capability methods specify the caller's normal attachment flow. Persistent output storage is a recommendation, not a specified retention requirement (SKILL.md:1–17,365–388; CAPABILITY.md:16–20,29–33,42–53).

data_operations.source: Manual setup commands and dependency manifests
data_operations.data_scope: Repository and dependency identifiers; no chart data appears in these commands.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: github.com/Cluka-399/chart-image.git and registry.npmjs.org when downloads are needed
data_operations.condition: Following manual installation instructions; actual installer requests and lifecycle behavior are unresolved.

data_operations.operation: Optional upstream metrics retrieval in a documentation example
data_operations.data_scope: A request for /metrics and the returned metrics; the example supplies no chart data in the request.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: api.example.com receives the request; chart.mjs receives the response through stdin.
data_operations.condition: Only when the caller follows this example; chart.mjs does not implement this fetch.

data_operations.operation: Accept and parse supplied inputs locally
data_operations.data_scope: Supplied records, field names, titles, annotations and rendering options; JSON, shorthand and CSV/TSV inputs are supported.
data_operations.condition: CLI data is parsed when supplied. Stdin is considered when neither a spec file nor CLI data selects the earlier paths; stdin may contain records, simplified options or a full spec.

data_operations.operation: Read explicitly selected local input files
data_operations.data_scope: The selected CSV file's contents or full Vega-Lite spec JSON
data_operations.condition: The corresponding flag is supplied. These reads are not themselves remote disclosure; capability guidance requires runtime-controlled file parameters.

data_operations.recipient_or_storage: A trusted temporary file created by the runtime/tooling layer
data_operations.condition: An alternative to passing JSON directly. File creation, supported handoff details and cleanup are not implemented in the supplied tooling.

data_operations.data_scope: Candlestick _bullish classification, histogram counts, extrema and regression endpoints
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Intermediate chart specification and resulting chart
data_operations.condition: Candlestick or histogram chart selection, or applicable --show-values and --trend-line options. These are numeric/chart derivations; no personal profiling is established.

data_operations.operation: Select recent records and calculate change annotations
data_operations.data_scope: Recent record slices and first-to-last arithmetic differences displayed with a percent sign
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Process memory, chart specification and resulting chart
data_operations.condition: The volume path slices before calculating change; the general path calculates change before slicing. The dual-axis path also slices recent records. Slicing does not delete source files.

data_operations.operation: Compile and render through local dependencies
data_operations.source: Generated specification or caller-supplied full specification
data_operations.data_scope: Embedded records, chart encodings, text and custom spec contents
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Vega-Lite compiler, Vega view and, for PNG, Sharp within the process
data_operations.condition: Rendering requires nonempty top-level spec.data.values. Custom specs otherwise reach the compiler without a resource-reference restriction; downstream resource loading remains unresolved.

data_operations.source: Rendered SVG or PNG buffer, optionally including watermark text
data_operations.data_scope: Visualized values, labels, titles, annotations and optional watermark
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: --output path, default chart.png; the entry recommends /data/clawd/tmp/
data_operations.condition: Successful generation writes SVG or PNG. The supplied completion path performs no output cleanup and specifies no retention period.

data_operations.operation: Return status and error text to the invoking runtime
data_operations.source: Selected output path, invalid options and caught error messages
data_operations.data_scope: Output filename/path, certain rejected option values and err.message
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: stdout/stderr and their caller; subsequent logging persistence is unknown.
data_operations.condition: Successful writes or validation/rendering failures. This return does not establish an independent remote recipient.

data_operations.operation: Return the image through the capability caller's attachment flow
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Capability caller and its normal file/attachment flow
data_operations.condition: Explicit fulfillment requirement for lineChart, barChart and areaChart. A return may remain with the caller; it does not prove a separate channel upload.

data_operations.operation: Instruct the agent to send the image to the user's channel
data_operations.source: Generated output file and brief caption
data_operations.data_scope: Chart image and caption, rather than a mandated copy of raw input records
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Message tool's target=<channel_id>, identified as the user's channel
data_operations.condition: The entry explicitly requires delivery after generation using action=send and filePath. The script itself supplies no messaging implementation.

potential_excess.data_scope: A change annotation derived from an older first record excluded by --focus-recent
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: The generated chart at --output, then the capability caller or user's channel when delivered
potential_excess.condition: The general chart path uses --show-change with --focus-recent and input longer than the requested window.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The entry recommends this combination for recent action only. The general implementation calculates change before selecting the recent window.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Render the recent window with its requested change annotation.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Calculate the annotation from the selected window. This narrows derived data within the required chart, rather than removing a delivery action.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Retain full-period change when explicitly requested and clearly identified. Preserve path-specific behavior; the volume path already calculates after slicing.

potential_excess.data_scope: Generated chart images retained after delivery, including their visible data and text
potential_excess.condition: The agent follows the persistent-path recommendation; no packaged post-delivery cleanup is provided.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Generating and delivering the image requires file availability during attachment handling, but the declared purpose specifies no subsequent retention period.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Keep the image available until delivery and any required retries finish.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use a managed temporary output lifetime and delete after confirmed delivery, unless durable saving is requested. Narrow persistence duration, not the required image generation or send.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Wait for attachment consumption/upload completion and preserve explicitly requested saved outputs.

potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Built-in intermediate specifications and the local Vega-Lite compiler
potential_excess.condition: Built-in chart inputs contain fields unused by the selected chart, options or derivations; records are embedded without field projection.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Chart generation needs the fields used for encodings and calculations. Unrelated columns are extra data within the required compilation action.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Compile the records and fields needed to reproduce the requested chart.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Project built-in chart records to referenced fields before constructing the compiler input. This finding establishes local processing scope, not remote disclosure or inclusion of unused fields in the final image.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep all fields needed by series, categories, OHLC, volume, bands and derivations. Apply no simple projection to arbitrary custom specs without resolving their field dependencies.

unknowns: Dependency implementations are absent. Their resource loading, telemetry, caching and error contents cannot be established. In particular, custom specs with nonempty inline values may also contain resource references; downstream local reads, remote recipients and disclosed request contents remain unresolved (scripts/package.json:4–8; scripts/chart.mjs:1780–1819,1965–1981).
Installer and lifecycle implementations are absent. Exact installation requests, credential use, caches and retention cannot be enumerated from commands and lockfile URLs.

Message and attachment tooling is absent. Exact channel selection, audience, upload boundaries, provider retention and deletion remain unresolved. The two documented delivery paths do not establish duplicate delivery.
Runtime temporary-input handling and filesystem lifecycle are absent. Access controls, backups, external cleanup and actual retention of input/output files remain unresolved.
